answer_1.quote: We focus on unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) of Question Generation (QG) and Passage Retrieval (IR)... We use BART to train a supervised QG model on NaturalQuestions.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate question generation using standard language generation metrics: BLEU1-4, METEOR and ROUGE L.

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluation on the model generated questions... three domain experts to rate a question as good or bad based on four attributes: Naturalness, Coverage, Factual Correctness, and Answerability.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each generated question as good or bad according to the four criteria: Naturalness, Coverage, Factual Correctness, Answerability.
